PDF Manager
Browsing, existing-text editing, annotations, page operations,
PL/EN/UK proofreading, and Google Drive integration.

winassoc.title: PDF File Association
winassoc.windows_only: This feature is only available on Windows.
winassoc.dev_mode_warning: The app is currently running from source (not as an installed program), so it can't be registered as the default. Use this option in the version installed via the installer.
winassoc.instructions: The app has been registered as an available option for PDF files. Windows Settings > Apps > Default apps will now open. Find „.pdf” or „PDF Manager” there and select this app — for security reasons Windows requires you to confirm this choice yourself. Afterwards, come back and use „Check Whether This App Is the Default for PDF” to verify it.
winassoc.status_yes: Yes — this app is currently the default program for opening PDF files.
winassoc.status_no: No — this app is not currently the default program for PDF files.
